description: This file contains test cases for the CallGraph utility in the server-side utilities of the project. It uses pytest to test the construction, node identification, and categorization of graph nodes representing function call traces, specifically testing the CallGraph class with sample JSON data.

classes.name: CallGraph
classes.description: A class representing the call graph constructed from a JSON trace, supporting node search and categorization.

methods.name: sample_trace()
methods.description: A pytest fixture that loads a sample trace JSON data from a file.

methods.name: test_call_graph_build(sample_trace)
methods.description: Tests that the CallGraph is correctly built from the sample trace and that nodes contain expected attributes.

methods.name: test_call_graph_build_and_tags(sample_trace)
methods.description: Tests the ability of the CallGraph to differentiate between internal and standard library nodes.
